name: 戴榮冠
objective:
This course is designed for international students with a Chinese proficiency level of A1. The course revolves around everyday life scenarios, guiding students to understand Taiwanese society, culture, and related life themes through text reading, topical discussions, classroom activities, and cultural experiences, helping them build a basic understanding of local culture.

The course content includes individual and group reports, cultural experience activities, and cultural experience worksheets. Students will learn relevant Chinese vocabulary and expressions through active participation and observation, and record, organize, and reflect on what they have learned through the worksheets. The course also includes assignments and diverse classroom exercises, providing ample opportunities for students to practice listening, speaking, reading, and writing, aiming to comprehensively improve their Chinese communication skills and intercultural understanding.
課程進度(1-16週):
Week 1 | Course Introduction: Objectives, Assessment, Cultural Experience, Exercises, and Applications of Generative AI

Week 2 | Self-Introduction and Daily Greetings: Name, Nationality, School, Hobbies, and Basic Politeness

Week 3 | Campus Life and Learning Environment: Classroom Language, Campus Location, and Student Life in Taiwan and Japan

Week 4 | Cultural Comparison: Differences in Daily Life, Eating Habits, Schedules, and Lifestyles between Taiwan and Japan

Week 5 | Cultural Experience: Taiwanese Cuisine and Ordering Practice, with Cultural Experience Exercises

Week 6 | Learning Chinese Using Generative AI: Vocabulary and Sentence Practice and Report Writing Using ChatGPT and Gemini

Week 7 | Cultural Experience: Taiwanese Tea Culture and Tea Tasting, with Cultural Experience Exercises

Week 8 | Midterm Group Presentation: Comparing Taiwanese and Japanese Culture in Simplified Chinese

Week 9 | Festivals and Family Culture: Taiwanese Festivals, Japanese Festivals, Family Addresses and Blessings

Week 10 | Shopping and Market Culture: Prices, Quantities, Preferences, Night Markets and Shopping Streets

Week 11 | Cultural Experience: Temple Culture, Worship Rituals and Religious Customs, and Cultural Experience Exercises

Week 12 | Cultural Experience: Feng Shui, Architecture, and Taiwanese Society and Culture

Week 13 | Individual Chinese Learning Report Writing (II): Review of Vocabulary, Sentence Structure, Paragraphs, and Cultural Comparison

Week 14 | Individual Chinese Learning Report Writing I: GIS and AI-Assisted Drafting

Week 15 | Individual Chinese Learning Report Writing II: GIS and Map Drawing Exercises

Week 16 | Final Report

Week 17 | 16+2 Flexible Learning Weeks: Submitting Learning Reflections

Week 18 | 16+2 Flexible Learning Weeks: Submitting Learning Reflections
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 學生分組實作及討論 (Student group practice and discussion)
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          During the 16 + 2 flexible learning weeks, students will explore Taiwanese daily life and culture through independent observation and practical activities. They will apply basic Chinese vocabulary and expressions, complete a short cultural assignment, and reflect on their learning experiences.
        
      

      
        時數 (小時)
        
          4
        
      

      
        學習成果
        
          Students will revise their final project based on feedback and produce a short video introducing Taiwanese culture. The final video will demonstrate their understanding of Taiwanese culture, basic Chinese communication skills, and ability to organize and present cultural content.
        
      

      
        評量比例
        
          Students will produce a short video on Taiwanese culture during the flexible learning weeks. The video will assess cultural understanding, content organization, and basic Chinese communication skills, accounting for 10% of the final grade.

remarks:
This course is designed for international students at the A1 Chinese level. It integrates Chinese language materials, daily-life topics, Taiwanese culture, and generative AI tools such as ChatGPT and Gemini.

Through reading, discussion, classroom activities, assignments, and cultural experiences, students will learn about Taiwanese society and culture while improving their listening, speaking, reading, and writing skills.
